caption: The drawing features a rectangular section at the center filled with a floral pattern set against a gray background. The pattern contains various types of stylized flowers and leaves in colors including red-orange, light yellow, pale pink, white, and green. The largest flower, positioned toward the center, is red-orange with white accents; smaller flowers in pale pink, white, and yellow are scattered throughout the composition. The green foliage and stems intertwine around the flowers, and the gray background appears textured with subtle variations in tone. Below the main floral section, there are two circular sketches in black and white, each containing a single outlined botanical element—on the left, a flower, and on the right, a large leaf. The rest of the page is uncolored, allowing the main section and the two sketches to stand out.
title: Woven Brocades
